d:
Three housewives are dissatisfied with the meagre income of their spouses. They step out to work, despite a resistance from their husbands who go to great lengths to stop them.
Movie:- Aamdani Atthanni Kharcha Rupaiya (2001)
Starcast:- Govinda, Tabu, Juhi Chawla, Chandrachur Singh, Johnny Lever, Isha Koppikar, Ketki Dave, Vinay Anand
Directed By:- K. Raghavendra Rao
Produced By:- G. Adiseshagiri Rao, G.V. Narasimha Rao
Music By:- Himesh Reshammiya
